decision: Ported the Origin export instead of inventing a scaffold. fc9f is the Bun and Nx base. The older branch supplies GET /health, the HTTP API, log groups, utils, and scope checks.

decision: Put the CDK app in apps/golf-api with src, tests, AGENTS.md, README.md, project.json, cdk.json, and cdk.context.json. Shared code is libs/utils. The generator is tools/generators.

decision: Left the AWS account and region unset. Log groups still keep one week and delete with the stack.

decision: Relative imports use a .js suffix, utils emits dist, and each package exports a file the boundary rule can resolve.
why: TypeScript NodeNext rejects extensionless imports. The boundary rule ignored packages that did not resolve to a file. A trial import of the generator from golf-api then failed lint.

decision: Ran tools/verify.sh. Lint, typecheck, test, build, and synth all exited 0. Synth had no AWS credential variables set.
why: The done check is those commands on the real tree.

why: The layout and the CDK files were already concrete. This repository is on GitHub.

decision: Removed the format note at the top of cdk-deploy-order.txt.
why: The filename already says the file is deploy order, and the runbook says to read it from top to bottom. The HttpApi name comment stays because HttpApi copies the construct id into the physical name.
